paper.abstract_en: The asymptotic symmetry group of asymptotically flat spacetimes gives rise to balance flux equations that constrain, fully non-perturbatively, the asymptotic strain measured by gravitational-wave detectors. Such constraints are sharp tools for identifying features such as the memory effect. As detector sensitivities improve, it becomes imperative to place the most promising beyond-GR candidates on the same footing. Whether the asymptotically flat framework applies to such theories at all is far from obvious and requires careful analysis of the additional degrees of freedom reaching future null infinity. In this work, we address this question. We integrate the Bondi-Sachs hierarchy in the presence of an arbitrary stress-energy tensor and extract the falloff conditions its components must satisfy for the standard metric decay to close. We then feed the most general scalar-vector-tensor (SVT) theory with second-order equations of motion through this framework. Recasting the field equations in the effective Einstein form $G_{μν}=T^{\rm eff}_{μν}/G_4(Φ,X)$ and evaluating every operator in the SVT Lagrangian against the falloff table, we condense the outcome into a constraint table for the coupling functionals and their derivatives at the asymptotic vacuum, sharpened by the additional equations of motion and vacuum stability. Remarkably few conditions survive. The scalar potential must vanish to cubic order at the asymptotic vacuum, the asymptotic Newton constant must be finite and positive, the scalar and vector modes must be canonically normalized, and the conformally coupled sector carries a frame subtlety. Every other coupling functional is protected by the theory's structure. The constraint table thus provides a diagnostic for screening beyond-GR models against asymptotic flatness and establishes the BMS group as the asymptotic symmetry group across the entire SVT class.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将渐近平坦时空的Bondi-Sachs框架推广至最一般的标量-矢量-张量理论，给出了耦合泛函在渐近真空的约束表，并论证BMS群在SVT类中仍是渐近对称群。选题属于广义相对论基础与渐近对称性核心问题，理论构建完整、非微扰、方法清晰，对超引力候选模型的筛选具有直接诊断价值，值得点入细读。
decision.title_zh: 超越广义相对论的渐近平坦性
decision.abstract_zh: 渐近平坦时空的渐近对称群给出了平衡通量方程，这些方程以完全非微扰的方式约束着引力波探测器所测量的渐近应变。此类约束是识别记忆效应等特征的锐利工具。随着探测器灵敏度的提高，将最有希望的超广义相对论候选者置于同一立足点就变得至关重要。渐近平坦框架是否根本适用于这类理论远非显而易见，需要仔细分析到达未来零无穷的额外自由度。在本工作中，我们处理这一问题。我们在存在任意应力-能量张量的情况下积分Bondi-Sachs层级结构，并提取其各分量必须满足的衰减条件，以使标准度规衰减得以自洽封闭。然后，我们将具有二阶运动方程的最一般标量-矢量-张量（SVT）理论送入这一框架。将场方程重写为有效爱因斯坦形式 $G_{μν}=T^{\rm eff}_{μν}/G_4(Φ,X)$，并对照衰减表评估SVT拉格朗日量中的每一个算符，我们将结果压缩为渐近真空处耦合泛函及其导数的约束表，并由额外运动方程和真空稳定性加以强化。令人惊讶的是，仅有极少条件存留下来。标量势在渐近真空处必须消失到三阶，渐近牛顿常数必须有限且为正，标量模和矢量模必须具有正则归一化，而共形耦合部分带有标架微妙性。其他所有耦合泛函都受到该理论结构的保护。因此，该约束表为筛选超越广义相对论模型是否满足渐近平坦性提供了一种诊断工具，并确立了BMS群作为整个SVT类的渐近对称群。
